summary: We developed a simple arcade-styled game, allowing you to control Voyager 1 and its journey away from planet Earth. We picked voyager 1 and introduced it with all its accomplishments over the years to spark interest in an almost 50 year old space probe in a short, simple, and fun way for all ages to enjoy.
details:
With Voyager 1 approaching the milestone of being a distance of one light-year away, our group has made a fun and informative game, allowing players to experience and learn all of Voyager 1's milestones and accomplishments. The game runs on simple mechanics and provides information alongside visuals, allowing hands on learning as users play along, gamifying a topic that might be difficult to process for younger players.

To create the game, we used Python as well as Claude to generate code, tweaking the code and using pillow library to make our own drawings. We linked data collected by NASA from Voyager 1's original launch to show the exact distance Voyager 1 has gone at the exact date, allowing users to feel the actual magnitude of distance Voyager 1 has gone. We have also added thrusters, mimicking the real thrusters on the actual Voyager 1.

We considered vertical and horizontal form facts, thinking about what type of devices would be used to play the game, ultimately landing on a horizontal form factor so the usage of simple arrow keys for movement could be used.
